text:
Married at first glance, the bride Jacqui Burfoot took to her dirty clothes at a completely different level during Sunday night’s commitment ceremony.
The 29 -year -old consultant embarrassed her boyfriend Ryan Donnelly on national television when she presented her gross bath habit of experts and other contestants.
As the unhappy couple rips over their romance in failure, Jacqui gave a brutal blow to Ryan, 36, revealing that he goes to the bathroom with the door open.
John Aiken began by telling the reality show shows: “Jacqui tells us what you see as the difficulties with this relationship.”
“Ryan does not listen to me,” he said, before remembering a moment that was forced to sleep “cold” because he would not increase the temperature in his hotel room.
‘It was quite cold. I suggested that we rose the temperature. But he wanted to lower the temperature, “he said.

‘I began to notice many things like leaving dirty clothes and shoes on bed. Do not close the bathroom (door) when you use the bathroom.
When John was shooting his eyes on the shallow confession, the other couples could be seen laughing and shrinking on the ‘difficulties’ that Jacqui and Ryan were having.
The couple has been on the rocks since last week, when Jacqui staggered after her husband Ryan brutally occupied her third in the controversial classification challenge.
However, experts revealed on Sunday that the explosive episode was even more messy behind the scene.
Jacqui placed Ryan confidently in the upper part of his list during the challenge, just for him to level it with a cold dose of “honesty” that left the producers fighting for a reaction.
“Jacqui was crying, but not for the reason they made him see,” said a source close to Jacqui to Daily Mail Australia.
“He was not injured because Ryan put his third: he was upset for being paired with a man who lacked emotional intelligence or depth to really put it first.”
According to privileged information, Jacqui never waited for Ryan to place her first, believing that she was around fourth in her eyes.

Jacqui’s close friend added that he was crying due to the horrible comments that Ryan made on the honeymoon that made her think that he was like “Andrew Tate.”
According to the reports, Jacqui did not feel personally crushed by the Ryan classification.
“Years have been building for their own love through modeling and competitions, so a man’s opinion was not willing to shake his trust,” the source explained.
“The producers were actually disappointed that it did not react anymore, so they edited in a crying scene from a completely different moment to increase the drama.”

The spectators hurried to Ryan’s behavior after doubting before placing Jacqui in third position, explaining that he was only being “100 percent honest.”
‘Ryan believes he is doing the right thing, but the reality is that Jacqui never asked for brutal honesty. I wanted to feel like the most special girl in the world, “the source said.
“Jacqui just wanted a husband to prioritize her and make her feel beautiful and special.”
“That task was a great disappointment for her because she only confirmed what she already suspected: Ryan was not the man who expected.”
From the beginning of the experiment, Jacqui made it clear that he was looking for intelligence and loyalty in a couple, the treatment he felt that they were missing in Ryan.
“She wanted a man with EQ and IQ, someone with consideration and devotion,” the source revealed.
“Instead, he obtained someone who thought about classifying her as a contestant in a beauty contest was the correct movement.”
